latvia.title: Latvia's insolvent Valka stops cooperation programs with Estonia's Valga
latvia.description: Cross-border cooperation projects between Estonia's Valga and Latvia's Valka have been suspended as the Latvian municipality is insolvent and must undergo a financial restructuring process.

latvia.title: Estonian border guards could be given additional powers to stop migrants
latvia.description: Estonian border guards could be given additional powers to stop border violators, Minister of Interior Igor Taro (Eesti 200) has said, after meeting with his Latvian counterpart.

latvia.title: Estonian raw milk producer buys Latvia's largest dairy company
latvia.description: Estonia's largest agricultural group, Agrone, on Friday finalized a deal to buy Latvia's largest dairy companies, Rīgas piena kombināts and Valmieras piens.

latvia.title: RFS wins a fourth Latvian football league title
latvia.description: The long-time leaders of the Latvian Football League (Virslīga), RFS, defeated Grobiņa 3:0 in Riga on Sunday, November 1st, and in the process secured a fourth Latvian league title for themselves.

latvia.title: Outgoing Latvian health minister quits party after 16 years
latvia.description: Outgoing Health Minister Hossams Abu Meri has decided to resign from the Unity political party (which technically sits within the slightly borader 'New Unity' political force) according to a statement on his Facebook account.

latvia.title: Riga Airport is looking for investors
latvia.description: RIX Riga Airport has launched a competitive selection process for the development of aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) hangars on the airport's territory, it announced on November 2nd.

latvia.title: NATO demonstrates its 'digital backbone' again in Latvia
latvia.description: NATO’s Digital Backbone eXperimentation (DiBaX 2026) took place in Latvia from October 19-30, under the leadership of NATO Allied Command Transformation (ACT), supported by the Latvian Ministry of Defence and the National Armed Forces, with LMT Defence as the technicalintegrator. It is a NATO experiment aimed at enhancing interoperability across domains through cutting-edge 5G and satellite communication technologies.

latvia.title: Latvia sends 'mobile surveillance device' to eastern border
latvia.description: Latvia's National Armed Forces (NBS) have deployed a first new "mobile surveillance device" on the Latvian state border to the Krāslava region, the NBS said in a release on November 2nd.

latvia.title: Latvia plans to buy Canadian 'Hellbender' helmets
latvia.description: Latvia's National Defence Logistics and Acquisition Centre (VALIC) has agreed with Canadian defence equipment manufacturer Galvion on the supply of "tactical helmet systems" for the National Armed Forces.

latvia.title: All Latvian electric trains now have names
latvia.description: The naming of the “Vivi” electric trains has been completed – the last four have now been given their names. Passengers will be carried by Lūsis (Lynx), Dzenis (Woodpecker), Kļava (Maple) and Alnis (Moose). This means that all 32 electric trains have now been named.

latvia.title: Latvian Prime Minister Kulbergs enjoys his rally passion with weekend win
latvia.description: While the attention of most of the motorsports world over the weekend was focussed on the crowning of the youngest ever Formula 1 world champion, Kimi Antonelli, 20, at the Mexican Grand Prix, there was a slightly slower motor race being run in the suburbs of Rīga involving a slightly older but no less remarkable personality.

latvia.title: Some nights will be frosty in Latvia this week
latvia.description: There will be no major changes in the weather this week, but forecasts suggest that on some nights the temperature will dip slightly below zero.

latvia.title: Rural tourism was pretty popular this summer in Latvia
latvia.description: Rural tourism has not seen a significant drop in bookings or visitor numbers this summer, although guests have become more frugal when it comes to dining. Despite a significant rise in costs, business owners are increasing food prices cautiously, Latvian Radio reported on November 2.

latvia.title: Traffic restricted in Rīga, Sarkandaugava due to fire Monday morning
latvia.description: On Monday morning, a fire broke out in an unoccupied building on Tvaika Street in Riga, and the road has been closed at the start of the street, according to the State Fire and Rescue Service (VUGD).

latvia.title: Bauska getting a head start on Christmas tree shopping
latvia.description: Although there are still just under two months to go until Christmas, Bauska is already thinking about the festive season. Residents have decided that, after a break of several years, a real Christmas tree will once again be erected in the town’s Town Hall Square. However, the change will not take place until next year, Zemgale Regional Television reported on November 2.

latvia.title: Grass growing under Latvian AI centre's feet
latvia.description: Latvia's Artificial Intelligence Centre (MIC) was established last April. The centre’s first director, Natālija Čerņecka, was appointed to the post last October and remained in the post for four months. She was succeeded by Guna Puce, who has not yet been in the post for a year. And now, once again, there is talk of structural changes at the centre, Latvian Television's De Facto reported on November 1.

latvia.title: Latvia takes charge of the United Nations Security Council for first time
latvia.description: November 1st, 2026 is an historic day, as for the first time ever Latvia will hold the presidency of the UN Security Council (UNSC). During this month, Latvia will chair all informal and formal UNSC meetings.

latvia.description: The defence industry across the Baltic states is growing significantly. The number of companies and employees has increased, revenues have risen and investment is expanding. latvia.title: The deal is done: Kārums belongs to the Estonians
latvia.description: One of Latvia's best-known and best-loved brands has fallen into the hands of our wily northern neighbours, it was confirmed on Friday.

latvia.title: Report: U.S. pressures Baltics not to say nasty things about Russia
latvia.description: Pentagon officials have urged several NATO allies, including the Baltic states, to tone down their public rhetoric about the threat posed by Russia, arguing that some statements by European leaders and official have undermined the continent’s security, according to Lithuanian public media LRT, citing a Reuters report.

latvia.title: New EUR 82m overpass to open this weekend in Rīga
latvia.description: The 82 million euro Kundziņsala flyover in Rīga has been completed and will open to traffic on November 1st, it has been confirmed.

latvia.title: Fuel thief detained in Rīga
latvia.description: On 25 October, law enforcement officers in Purvciems, Rīga, arrested a man born in 1984 who is suspected of 15 incidents of fuel theft in Riga.

latvia.title: NATO minesweepers arrive in Liepāja port
latvia.description: On October 30th, two ships of the Standing NATO Maritime Mine Countermeasures Group 1 (SNMCMG1) arrived in the port of Liepāja.

latvia.title: Railways more popular in Latvia than in Estonia or Lithuania
latvia.description: New Eurostat data published on October 29th confirms that Latvians like to use their railways more than their neighbours to the north and south.

latvia.description: Rail Baltica is currently in a situation where one of the most significant risks to the future progress of the project is not technical readiness or construction capacity, but the timeliness and consistency of political decisions.

latvia.title: Paskaties spogulī: 5 izmaiņas uz mēles, kas var liecināt par nopietnām veselības problēmām
latvia.description: Ikdienā mēli, visticamāk, pārbaudām tikai zobu tīrīšanas laikā, taču tās izskata izmaiņas dažkārt var liecināt par veselības problēmām. Neparasts aplikums, ilgstoša čūla, izteikts apsārtums vai citas pārmaiņas var būt saistītas gan ar uzturvielu trūkumu un mutes dobuma infekcijām, gan retākos gadījumos ar nopietnākām slimībām. Taču ir svarīgi atcerēties, ka tikai pēc mēles izskata nav iespējams […]

lithuania.title: Allies fear Trump will target NATO in case of midterm loss
lithuania.description: The U.S. president could move thousands more troops out of Europe or cut NATO funding as he seeks to cement his legacy, diplomats say.

lithuania.title: INTERVIEW: Lithuania fears calls for return to Russian gas amid price shock
lithuania.description: Brussels must also honour pledge to ban Kremlin oil, says energy minister Lukas Savickas

lithuania.title: Divided Bulgaria votes in tense presidential runoff
lithuania.description: The first round in the European Union and NATO member state was marked by record-low turnout

lithuania.title: 800 ezret fizetnek a hackerek azoknak, akik ellátás nélkül maradtak egy kórház elleni támadás miatt
lithuania.description: Bocsánatot kértek a hackerek azoktól a betegektől, akiket érintett egy amerikai intézmény ellen indított támadásuk. Kárpótlást is ígérnek, de nem tudni, hogy ez valós-e.

lithuania.title: Martha Stewart belátta, „nagyon elszúrta”, hogy hajléktalannak öltözött Halloweenre
lithuania.description: A dollármilliomos azóta törölte a képet, és bocsánatot kért az „érzéketlen” jelmezválasztásért.

lithuania.title: Mi marad Trumpból? – a holnapi félidős választás esélyeit mérlegeli a világsajtó
lithuania.description: Trump most szembesül tettei következményeivel, és nem áll jól? Mit kell tennie a Demokrata Pártnak, ha nyer? Nem kell aggódni, az USA megvédené Európát egy orosz támadás esetén. Senki se higgye, hogy vége az amerikai-kínai vámháborúnak. Nem történt puccs Lengyelországban, de dúl a hatalmi harc a konzervatív és a liberális erők között. Témák és vélemények a világsajtóból.

lithuania.title: Martha Stewart hajléktalannak öltözött halloweenkor, aztán nagy nehezen, de rájött, hogy ez annyira nem mókás
lithuania.description: A milliárdos végül először magyarázkodott, majd másodszorra bocsánatot is kért.

lithuania.title: A legrosszabbra készül a NATO: Trump esetleges veresége drámai következményekkel járhat
lithuania.description: A NATO európai tagállamai a legrosszabb forgatókönyvre készülnek a keddi amerikai félidős választások előtt. Diplomáciai források szerint a szövetségesek attól tartanak, hogy egy esetleges republikánus vereség után a belpolitikában megbénított Donald Trump a külpolitikában próbál majd látványos lépéseket tenni - tudósított a Politico .

lithuania.title: Kongatják a vészharangot: Putyin ezzel mindent láthatna Európában, hatalmas előnyt szerezhetnek az oroszok
lithuania.description: Oroszország hamarosan befejezi egy hatalmas radarkomplexum építését a kalinyingrádi exklávéban, amellyel szinte egész Európát megfigyelés alatt tarthatja, ezzel növelve a feszültséget az oroszok és a NATO között - közölte a Deutsche Welle .

lithuania.title: Tisza-kormány: megszüntetik a volt államfők kiváltságait, a Tisza támogatja Fejes Pétert
lithuania.description: A parlamentben a következő napokban többek között az ügynökakták nyilvánosságáról, a magántőkealapokról, a milliárdosok vagyonadójáról, a december 24-i munkaszüneti napról és a 2027-es költségvetésről is tárgyalnak, valamint dönthetnek az új legfőbb ügyész személyéről. A Tisza-frakció támogatja Fejes Péter legfőbb ügyésszé választását. November 4-én megkezdődik az állambiztonsági iratok nyilvánosságra hozatala. Magyar Péter miniszterelnök hétfői, parlamenti felszólalásában arról is beszélt, hogy a költségvetési vitában megszüntetik a volt köztársasági elnökök évi több tízmillió forintos, alapítványi támogatásokra fordítható keretét. Kapitány István egy reggeli rádióinterjúban arról beszélt, hogy nem vezetik ki a rezsicsökkentést. Bombafenyegetés miatt megszakította útját egy Londonból Szófiába tartó Wizz Air-járat, amely Budapesten kért leszállási engedélyt. A NATO légvédelmi készenléti szolgálata ALPHA-riasztást rendelt el.

lithuania.title: Bombová hrozba na palube Wizz Air. Lietadlo pri núdzovom pristátí v Budapešti sprevádzal Gripen
lithuania.description: Do vzduchu sa stíhačka dostala v priebehu niekoľkých minút po vyhlásení ostrého poplachu NATO. Gripen následne odletel späť na základňu v Kecskeméte.

lithuania.title: Odkiaľ pochádza strach zo smrti? Toto sú hlavné príznaky tanatofóbie
lithuania.description: Tanatofóbia, teda strach zo smrti, je psychologický problém, ktorý zasahuje do života mnohých ľudí. Ide o pretrvávajúci pocit úzkosti spojený s myšlienkami na vlastnú smrť, ktorý môže výrazne ovplyvniť každodenné fungovanie. Aké sú najčastejšie príznaky tanatofóbie? Čo spôsobuje strach zo smrti? A ako sa s tanatofóbiou vyrovnať?

lithuania.title: Trump caută țapi ispășitori pentru eșecul răsunător al războiului cu Iranul. Capul cui ar putea să cadă „pe altarul” liderului SUA
lithuania.description: Războiul cu Iranul, care s-a prelungit mai mult de opt luni și a dus la creșterea prețurilor la combustibil în SUA până la niveluri record, i-a costat scump pe Donald Trump și pe republicani. Aceștia riscă să piardă alegerile intermediare pentru Congres, înaintea cărora președintele a promis că nu va relua acțiunile militare împotriva Iranului. Pentru perioada de după alegeri, a fost pregătit un plan de lansare a unor atacuri și mai masive asupra Iranului, care, după cum se tem țările din Golful Persic, vor duce la distrugeri și mai mari și la destabilizarea regiunii, scriu Bloomberg și Financial Times.

lithuania.title: Exit-poll în Bulgaria: candidata pro-rusă Iliana Iotova conduce în alegerile prezidențiale, cu 57,4% din voturi
lithuania.description: Iliana Iotova este pe cale să obțină un mandat de cinci ani la conducerea Bulgariei, potrivit primelor exit-poll-uri publicate la închiderea urnelor. Candidata susținută de formațiunea premierului Rumen Radev conduce în fața lui Andrei Ghiurov, care a mizat pe o platformă pro-occidentală și pe apropierea de UE și NATO, potrivit Novinite.

lithuania.title: Un fost agent Mossad l-ar fi ajutat pe Flavio Bolsonaro să fugă din Brazilia. Cum a fost organizată operațiunea secretă (presă)
lithuania.description: Un fost agent al serviciului israelian de informații Mossad l-ar fi ajutat pe senatorul brazilian Flavio Bolsonaro, fiul fostului președinte Jair Bolsonaro, să fugă din Brazilia prin Argentina, încălcând o interdicție judecătorească de a părăsi țara. Operațiunea ar fi fost pregătită înaintea turului al doilea al alegerilor prezidențiale și ar fi beneficiat de sprijinul unor persoane influente din Argentina și Statele Unite, relatează The Jerusalem Post, preluat de News.ro.

lithuania.title: Marco Rubio neagă o implicare directă a Washingotnului în fuga lui Flavio Bolsonaro din Brazilia
lithuania.description: Secretarul de stat american Marco Rubio a declarat sâmbătă că Washingtonul nu a fost implicat direct în aranjamentele făcute de senatorul Flavio Bolsonaro de a părăsi Brazilia după înfrângerea sa în cel de-al doilea tur al alegerilor prezidenţiale, relatează duminică AFP.

lithuania.title: Obsesia Generației Z pentru ridicatul de greutăți și legătura cu Napoleon. De ce renunță tinerii la alergat pentru sala de forță
lithuania.description: Peste un sfert dintre tinerii adulți din Marea Britanie spun în prezent că abonamentele la sală contează mai mult pentru ei decât vacanțele sau mâncatul în oraș. Datele Sport England arată că Generația Z a început să se îndepărteze de alergare, înot și cursuri de fitness și să se orienteze către sală și antrenamentul de forță. Pentru ei, antrenamentul cu greutăți este considerat cea mai bună formă de exercițiu, pentru că poate ajuta la dezvoltarea forței, la îmbunătățirea aspectului și la îmbunătățirea sănătății generale.

lithuania.title: AUR preia tema PSD privind ascunderea cifrelor bugetare / Petrișor Peiu anunță moțiune simplă împotriva lui Alexandru Nazare: „Să explice care este adevăratul deficit bugetar”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a anunţat, luni, că va depune o moţiune simplă împotriva ministrului de Finanţe, Alexandru Nazare, pentru ca acesta să dea explicaţii despre „adevăratul” deficit bugetar, preluând practic tema de la PSD, scrie Agerpres. „Văzând că domnul prim-ministru a invocat o întâlnire cu sindicatele azi pentru a evita să vină în […] © G4Media.ro .

lithuania.title: NATO demonstrates its 'digital backbone' again in Latvia
lithuania.description: NATO’s Digital Backbone eXperimentation (DiBaX 2026) took place in Latvia from October 19-30, under the leadership of NATO Allied Command Transformation (ACT), supported by the Latvian Ministry of Defence and the National Armed Forces, with LMT Defence as the technicalintegrator. It is a NATO experiment aimed at enhancing interoperability across domains through cutting-edge 5G and satellite communication technologies.

lithuania.title: Report: U.S. pressures Baltics not to say nasty things about Russia
lithuania.description: Pentagon officials have urged several NATO allies, including the Baltic states, to tone down their public rhetoric about the threat posed by Russia, arguing that some statements by European leaders and official have undermined the continent’s security, according to Lithuanian public media LRT, citing a Reuters report.

lithuania.title: NATO minesweepers arrive in Liepāja port
lithuania.description: On October 30th, two ships of the Standing NATO Maritime Mine Countermeasures Group 1 (SNMCMG1) arrived in the port of Liepāja.

lithuania.title: Railways more popular in Latvia than in Estonia or Lithuania
lithuania.description: New Eurostat data published on October 29th confirms that Latvians like to use their railways more than their neighbours to the north and south.

lithuania.title: Trampa sakāve vēlēšanās var radīt nopietnus draudus NATO: sabiedrotie gatavojas sliktākajam scenārijam
lithuania.description: ASV prezidenta Donalda Trampa politiskais stāvoklis var ietekmēt arī NATO nākotni. Ja republikāņi zaudēs gaidāmajās starpvēlēšanās, Tramps varētu pastiprināt kritiku pret aliansi un pat lemt par plašāku ASV karaspēka izvešanu no Eiropas, vēsta “Politico”, atsaucoties uz pieciem NATO valstu diplomātiem. Eiropas sabiedrotie bažījas, ka Republikāņu partijas sakāve vēlēšanās varētu mudināt Trampu vēl asāk vērsties pret […]

lithuania.title: “Es viņam dotu 70%!” Rajevs liek likmes, kurš varētu būt nākamais Ukrainas prezidents
lithuania.description: Ja Ukrainā izdotos sarīkot brīvas valsts prezidenta vēlēšanas, par Volodimira Zelenska nopietnāko konkurentu varētu kļūt pašreizējais Ukrainas vēstnieks Lielbritānijā un bijušais Ukrainas bruņoto spēku virspavēlnieks Valērijs Zalužnijs. Šādu prognozi TV24 raidījumā “Par karu Ukrainā” izteica Saeimas deputāts, NBS rezerves pulkvedis Igors Rajevs, kurš vērtēja iespējamos kandidātus un viņu izredzes. Rajevs par Zalužnija uzvaras iespējām izteicās […]

lithuania.title: Jordanijos karalius: Be palestiniečių tėvynės Artimuosiuose Rytuose nebus saugumo,
lithuania.description: Jordanijos karalius Abdullah II (Abdula II) pirmadienį pareiškė, kad Artimųjų Rytų regione saugumo nebus, kol nebus įgyvendinta palestiniečių teisė į tėvynę.

lithuania.title: Klaipėda sieks surengti Europos plaukimo čempionatą 2031 arba 2033 metais
lithuania.description: Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybė sieks 2031 arba 2033 metais surengti Europos plaukimo trumpajame baseine čempionatą, kuris būtų pirmasis tokio lygio suaugusiųjų plaukimo čempionatas Lietuvoje.

lithuania.title: Panevėžio rajone tvenkinyje rastas nuskendęs 20-metis
lithuania.description: Pirmadienį Panevėžio rajone, Upytės kaime, tvenkinyje rastas nuskendęs 20 metų jaunuolis.

lithuania.title: Kinijos užsienio reikalų ministras: Pekinas remia Irano suvereniteto gynimą
lithuania.description: Kinijos diplomatijos vadovas aukšto rango Irano pareigūnui pirmadienį pareiškė, kad Pekinas remia Teheraną ginant „savo suverenitetą ir saugumą“.

lithuania.title: Tarptautinėje NATO operacijoje jūroje dalyvauja Lietuvos karo medikai
lithuania.description: Lietuvos karinių jūrų pajėgų vadovaujamoje NATO Nuolatinės parengties priešmininių laivų grupėje dirba Lietuvos kariuomenės Jono Basanavičiaus karo medicinos tarnybos karo medikai.

lithuania.title: Prezidento šimtmetis: 100 Valdo Adamkaus gyvenimo įvykių
lithuania.description: Nuo gimimo atkurtos Lietuvos valstybės laikinojoje sostinėje iki ilgos išeivijos JAV, neblėstant tėvynės meilei, ir dviejų vadovavimo šaliai laikotarpių – eksprezidento Valdo Adamkaus artėjančio šimtmečio proga naujienų agentūra BNS apžvelgia 100 svarbiausių jo gyvenimo įvykių.

lithuania.title: Įstrigus deryboms dėl biudžeto, Belgijos premjeras Bartas De Weveris pasiūlė atsistatydinti
lithuania.description: Įstrigus deryboms dėl biudžeto, Belgijos ministras pirmininkas Bartas De Weveris (Bartas De Veveris) pirmadienį įteikė atsistatydinimo pareiškimą karaliui Philippe'ui (Pilypui).

lithuania.title: Trumpas pranoko Bideną: degalų kainos JAV artėja prie istorinio rekordo
lithuania.description: Antrosios Donaldo Trumpo prezidentavimo kadencijos metu vidutinės degalų kainos JAV beveik pasiekė visų ankstesnių administracijų laikotarpių rekordą. Ypač smarkiai pabrango dyzelinas, praneša „Financial Times“.

lithuania.title: Už informaciją apie narkobaroną Josą Leijdekkersą Nyderlandai siūlo rekordinę 2 mln. eurų premiją
lithuania.description: Nyderlandų institucijos siūlo rekordinį dviejų milijonų eurų atlygį už informaciją, kuri padėtų sulaikyti vieną labiausiai Europoje ieškomų narkotikų prekeivių Josą Leijdekkersą (Josą Lidekersą), šiuo metu besislapstantį Siera Leonėje.

lithuania.title: Po antro jūrų pėstininko sulaikymo Japonija ragina JAV užtikrinti karių drausmę
lithuania.description: Po to, kai komendanto valandos metu dėl įtariamo vairavimo išgėrus buvo sulaikytas jūrų pėstininkas, Japonija paragino Jungtines Valstijas užtikrinti savo karių drausmę, pirmadienį pareiškė gynybos ministras.

lithuania.title: Lietuva siekia stiprinti tarptautinę serialų gamybą
lithuania.description: Lietuva siekia stiprinti tarptautinę serialų gamybą, ruošiamasi pasirašyti tai numatančią Europos Tarybos konvenciją.

lithuania.title: Prancūzijoje po atostogų atnaujinami riboti protestai mokyklose
lithuania.description: Prancūzijos mokiniai, grįžę po rudens atostogų, pirmadienį blokavo kai kurias vidurines mokyklas, pasiryžę atgaivinti protestų judėjimą, nepaisant pasiūlytų vyriausybės nuolaidų.

lithuania.title: Pasibaigus paliauboms, Rusija atnaujino Chersono srities puolimą
lithuania.description: Pasibaigus vietos paliauboms, Rusija pirmadienį atnaujino Ukrainos Chersono srities puolimą, pranešė Kyjivas.

lithuania.title: Iranas teigia esąs pasirengęs atverti Hormuzo sąsiaurį per dvi dienas jei JAV sutiks su reikalavimais
lithuania.description: Iranas pranešė esąs pasirengęs per dvi dienas vėl atverti Hormuzo sąsiaurį, jei JAV sutiks su jo sąlygomis, nors anksčiau siūlė vienos savaitės terminą.

lithuania.title: Po operacijos Hebrone Izraelio kariuomenė atsitraukė
lithuania.description: Po operacijos okupuoto Vakarų Kranto Hebrono mieste Izraelio kariuomenė atsitraukė, pirmadienį pranešė kariuomenės pareigūnas.

lithuania.title: Kalėdų eglių lenktynės prasideda: kokiomis staigmenomis nustebins Lietuvos miestai?
lithuania.description: Pirmieji iš penkių didžiųjų Lietuvos miestų Kalėdų egles lapkričio 27 dieną įžiebs Kaunas ir Panevėžys, diena vėliau šventinės eglės sužibs Vilniuje ir Klaipėdoje, o gruodžio 5-ąją – Šiauliuose.

lithuania.title: Floridoje sudužo nedidelis lėktuvas – žuvo visi keleiviai
lithuania.description: Nedidelis privatus lėktuvas sudužo gyvenamajame Floridos rajone, praneša „ABC news“. JAV pareigūnų teigimu, žuvo visi devyni juo skridę žmonės.

lithuania.title: Šventu laikomame Kinijos kalne varžėsi kiaušiniais nešini robotai
lithuania.description: Valstybinė žiniasklaida praneša, kad dešimtys kiaušiniais ir arbūzais nešinų robotų pirmadienį kilo daugiau kaip 3 tūkst. laiptelių į vieną garsiausių Kinijos viršūnių lenktynėse, kurias organizatoriai pavadino robotų ištvermės realiomis sąlygomis išbandymu.

lithuania.title: Per sprogdinimą Kolumbijos vakaruose žuvo keturi žmonės
lithuania.description: Kolumbijos vakaruose sekmadienį sprogus sprogmenų prikrautam sunkvežimiui, žuvo keturi žmonės, įskaitant dviejų mėnesių kūdikį, pranešė vietos pareigūnai.
